lines.zh: 我走向下方世界的台阶。
lines.en: I walk toward the steps of the Underworld.
Each step presses gravity down.
My train sweeps the ash.

lines.zh: 我一抬手，碎石纷纷离地。
lines.en: I raise a hand and rubble lifts.
I pass a chasm.
The ground sinks under me.
I walk toward the black hole.
It hangs there, swallowing light.
I stop and look.
I stand beside the black hole.
Light bends away from me.
My hands hang steady.
There is no time here.
Or rather, I decide it.
I raise my eyes to the distance.
The Underworld is empty.
I turn my wrist slowly.
Space shifts with it.
I look down at my shadow.
It doesn't follow me.
I raise a hand and it returns.
This ground is mine to tread.
I stand in this underworld and wait.

lines.zh: 这块地是我踏的，慢慢来。
lines.en: This ground is mine to tread. Slowly.
No hurry. I can afford to wait.
By the black hole, I look down at you.
Gravity will teach you.
I raise a single finger.
You're pressed into a stoop.

lines.zh: 你被压弯了腰，我这才收手。
lines.en: You're bent double. Only then do I lower my hand.
I lower my hand and you straighten.

lines.zh: 你挺直了腰，这只是一记提醒。
lines.en: You straighten up. That was a reminder.

lines.zh: 下层世界不欢迎站着的活物。
lines.en: The under-world does not welcome the standing.
But since you're here.

lines.zh: 这儿轮不到你站，我背过身。
lines.en: This isn't yours to stand in. I turn away.
I turn away. Follow.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，空间晃了一下。
lines.en: I step back and space shudders.
My train tears.

lines.zh: 空间抖了一下，我一声不响。
lines.en: Space shudders. I stay silent.

lines.zh: 我抬了抬手，把身子稳住。
lines.en: I raise a hand to steady myself.
Gravity slips for a moment.
The rubble all falls.

lines.zh: 重力失控了一瞬，我慢慢站直。
lines.en: Gravity slips for a moment. I straighten slowly.

lines.zh: 碎石尽数落尽，你确实伤了我。
lines.en: The rubble all falls away. You did hurt me.
You hurt me. That isn't easy.

lines.zh: 能伤到我很难得，我记下了。
lines.en: Hurting me is rare. I'll remember it.

lines.zh: 我吞的是光，不是你的供品。
lines.en: I swallow light, not your offerings.
What I consume is time and space.
That isn't even a bite.
You're holding it up so earnestly.
I raise a hand and it drifts away.
It drifts away into the black hole.

lines.zh: 一入黑洞，便什么也不剩。
lines.en: Into the black hole. Nothing remains.
You see. That's how it is.

lines.zh: 瞧见了？下回空着手来就行。
lines.en: See? Next time come empty-handed.
You hit me and are pressed to the floor.
I haven't even raised a finger.

lines.zh: 我一根指头都没抬，重力够用。
lines.en: I haven't raised a finger. Gravity suffices.
Gravity is enough. You get up.

lines.zh: 你撞上重力场，跪了下去。
lines.en: You hit my gravity field and drop to your knees.

lines.zh: 你居然爬起来，身子骨不差。
lines.en: You get up. Fairly sturdy.
I step aside.

lines.zh: 我挪开半步，你还在那儿喘。
lines.en: I step aside. You're still panting.
You're panting. I'll let it go.

lines.zh: 这回我不追究，别再试第二回。
lines.en: I'll let it be. Don't try again.
The King is in another world.
A whole world lies between us.
But we both sit.
Each on our own world.

lines.zh: 我抬手指，端详那枚戒指。
lines.en: I raise my hand and study the ring.

lines.zh: 我抬手端详戒指，它正在变暗。
lines.en: I raise my hand. The ring is darkening.

lines.zh: 戒指回到指根，黑洞并未停歇。
lines.en: The ring goes back on. The black hole never stops.
I keep standing. There's plenty of time.
The black hole turns. There's plenty of time.

lines.zh: 黑洞把碎块吸到我掌心。
lines.en: A black hole pulls the shard to my palm.

lines.zh: 它自己悬起，我一根指头也没动。
lines.en: It lifts on its own. I never touched it.

lines.zh: 它悬在我掌前，我端详了一下。
lines.en: It halts before my palm. I examine it.
A shard of blood crystal.

lines.zh: 原来是片血晶碎屑，毫无用处。
lines.en: A shard of blood crystal. Useless.
Useless. I let go.

lines.zh: 我一松手，它径直坠入黑洞。
lines.en: I open my hand and it drops in.
Without a sound.

lines.zh: 落进去声息全无，我接着走。
lines.en: It falls without a sound. I walk on.
You've stepped into my field.

lines.zh: 你站进我的场，我开始施压。
lines.en: You've stepped into my field. I begin to press.
The ground sinks a block.

lines.zh: 地面沉了一格，我抬起手。
lines.en: The ground sinks a block. I raise a hand.

lines.zh: 我一抬手，黑洞便转动起来。
lines.en: I raise a hand and the black hole turns.
You're dragged toward it.
You grab a stone.
You grab a stone. It shatters.
You catch a crack.

lines.zh: 你抓住裂缝，我慢慢加力。
lines.en: You catch a crack. I increase the pressure.
The crack widens in your grip.
The crack widens. You're still holding.

lines.zh: 你撑到现在，倒让我意外。
lines.en: You're still holding. That surprises me.
Then heavier.
I turn my palm over.
Space flips.

lines.zh: 空间整个翻转，你掉了下去。
lines.en: Space flips over. You fall.

lines.zh: 落地声很轻，你站起来了。
lines.en: A quiet landing. You're up again.
You're up again. Good.
I raise a hand for the second wave.
A shockwave spreads from my feet.
The ground behind you splits.

lines.zh: 冲击把你推开，你跃过裂口。
lines.en: The shock shoves you back. You leap the gap.
You leap it. I walk forward.
Each step deepens the gravity.
Your movements slow.
Your breathing is heavy too.
I point at the black hole.

lines.zh: 我朝黑洞一指，它开始吸扯。
lines.en: I point at the black hole. It begins to pull.
The rubble goes first.
Then the soil at your feet.

lines.zh: 接着是脚边的浮土，你伏低身子。
lines.en: Then the loose soil at your feet. You drop low.
Clever.

lines.zh: 这招够聪明，可惜起不了作用。
lines.en: Clever. It won't help.
The last layer even slows time.

lines.zh: 最后一层连时辰都缓，我展了开。
lines.en: The last layer slows even time. I unfold it.
I raise a hand and gravity falls.
You're pressed into the ground.
I take half a step forward.
The shockwave flips you.
The black hole draws the rubble in.
You catch the edge.
It comes down and the ground collapses.
You roll clear.
I bring my hands together.

lines.zh: 双手一合，空间被生生挤紧。
lines.en: My hands close and space is crushed.

lines.zh: 你被夹在中间，我松开一点。
lines.en: You're caught between. I loosen a little.
I won't keep loosening.

lines.zh: 我早晚要收力，你最好准备。
lines.en: I'll stop easing off soon. Be ready.
Be ready. The next one is heavier.

lines.zh: 我从下方世界的裂口走上来。
lines.en: I come up through a rift in the Underworld.
The ground begins to sink.

lines.zh: 我身上的光把灰照白了。
lines.en: The light on me bleaches the ash.
A black hole forms behind me.

lines.zh: 黑洞在我背后，它慢慢转。
lines.en: The black hole is behind me. It turns slowly.
I raise a hand and study it.
These hands can press space itself.
I lower my hand. It's very empty here.

lines.zh: 四下空旷，却有一点声响。
lines.en: It's empty, but there's a sound.
Light footsteps.

lines.zh: 身后脚步极轻，我扭头去看。
lines.en: Light steps behind me. I turn my head.
Something living is over there.

lines.zh: 那侧有活物气息，我走过去。
lines.en: Something living over there. I walk toward it.
The ground sinks with me.

lines.zh: 脚下地面陷落，黑洞尾随而至。
lines.en: The ground sinks. The black hole follows.
It follows. Always.

lines.zh: 它自会缀在身后，我无须奔跑。
lines.en: It trails me. I needn't run.
It will bring them to me.

lines.zh: 它自会把人送来，我不必追。
lines.en: It will bring them. I needn't chase.

lines.zh: 火在我的场里熄了，只烫到边缘。
lines.en: Fire dies in my field, only scorching the edge.

lines.zh: 我落下去，地面被我压塌。
lines.en: I fall and the ground collapses under me.

lines.zh: 水在我周围悬着，我还能呼吸。
lines.en: Water hangs around me; I can still breathe.
The blast is crushed into a knot.

lines.zh: 弹丸在我面前停住，然后落下。
lines.en: A round halts before me, then drops.
Two powers pull against each other.
It isn't food I burn.
Lightning is pressed into a line.

lines.zh: 这里就是虚空，我掉得很慢。
lines.en: This is the void. I fall slowly.
